name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.mem_netNodes
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (v : Nat),
  Iff
    (Membership.mem.{0, 0}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.network g)) v)
    (Or
      (∃ r,
        And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.reps g) r)
          (Eq.{1} v (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 r)))
      (Or
        (∃ r,
          And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.reps g) r)
            (Eq.{1} v (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 r) 1)))
        (Or (Eq.{1} v (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netS g))
          (Eq.{1} v (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netT g)))))

source.code:
theorem mem_netNodes (v : ℕ) :
    v ∈ g.network.nodes ↔ (∃ r ∈ g.reps, v = 2 * r) ∨ (∃ r ∈ g.reps, v = 2 * r + 1) ∨
      v = g.netS ∨ v = g.netT := by
  show v ∈ (g.repsL g.base.canonIds).map (fun r => 2 * r) ++
    (g.repsL g.base.canonIds).map (fun r => 2 * r + 1) ++ [g.netS, g.netT] ↔ _
  have hr : g.repsL g.base.canonIds = g.reps := rfl
  rw [hr]
  simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
  constructor
  · rintro ((⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩) | h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h))
  · rintro (⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | h | h)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
